docs.title: Contacts, Products, Units of Measure, and Reference Data

sections.text: Clean master data keeps Sales, Purchasing, Inventory, and Accounting consistent. Customers and vendors share a single **Contacts** directory, while physical goods and services share one **Products** catalog with variants, pricing, tracking, and units of measure.

1. Open **Contacts** from the app switcher (or open **Sales → Orders → Customers** / **Purchase → Orders → Vendors**—note that **Purchase → Orders → Vendors** automatically activates the **Vendors** filter chip, which you can clear via × to browse all contacts). 2. Switch between **List** and **Kanban** views using the top-right view switcher, search by name, email, phone, reference, or tax ID, or filter by **Companies**, **Individuals**, or **Archived**. You can also bulk-upload contacts via **Import / Export → Import records** (see [Guided Data Import & Export](/en/next/user/data-import-and-export.md)). 3. Click **New** (or open an existing contact) to edit: * **Type**: Choose whether the record is a company or an individual contact (individuals can be linked under a parent company so they inherit company billing and shipping addresses). * **Address & Tax ID**: Maintain street, city, postal code, country, and Tax ID so invoices and tax reports populate accurately. * **Contact Details**: Store phone, mobile, email, website, and tags for segmentation. * **Accounting & Payment Defaults**: Assign default payment terms, fiscal position, and bank accounts when working with AR/AP. * **Chatter & Activities**: Log internal notes, send messages/external emails, and click **Activity** to schedule follow-up reminders directly on the contact. 4. Click **Save**. All modules immediately share the updated contact information. ![Contacts supports both List and Kanban card views with Companies and Individuals filters.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/getting-started/contacts-kanban.webp) ![A Contact form centralizes company details, addresses, tax ID, and full chatter and activity history across Sales, Purchasing, and Accounting.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/getting-started/contacts-form.webp)

Products can be opened from **Sales → Products → Products**, **Purchase → Products → Products**, or **Inventory → Products → Products**: 1. Click **New** to create a product template, or select an existing product to edit it. 2. On the **General Information** tab, configure: * **Product Type**: * **Goods (Storable / Stockable)**: Tracked in warehouse locations with on-hand stock quantities, deliveries, receipts, and inventory valuation. * **Consumable**: Delivered/received without strict on-hand stock blocking. * **Service**: Non-physical items (consulting, maintenance, freight, subscriptions) that skip warehouse transfers. * **Sales Price & Cost**: Default selling price and standard/average cost used for margin calculations and stock valuation. * **Internal Reference & Barcode**: SKU code and scannable barcode (EAN/GS1) for fast lookup in orders and warehouse transfers. * **Product Category & Units of Measure**: Controls default accounting income/expense/valuation accounts and stock vs. purchase units. 3. On the **Attributes & Variants** tab, add attributes (such as Color, Size, or Storage Capacity) to generate sellable **Product Variants** automatically. View all variants under **Products → Product Variants**. 4. Use the dedicated commercial, procurement, warehouse, and tax tabs on the product notebook: * **Sales**: Configure the **Invoicing Policy** (ordered vs. delivered quantities) and sales options. * **Purchase**: Configure vendor billing control (**Purchase Method**), vendor pricelists, and purchase notice warnings. * **Inventory**: Configure **Traceability** (No Tracking, By Lots, By Unique Serial Number), **Expiration Date** settings (when expiry is enabled), routes (Buy, Manufacture, Replenish on Order), and logistics weight/volume. * **Accounting**: Set default **Customer Taxes** and **Vendor Taxes** applied automatically on orders and invoices. 5. Use the top smart buttons (**On Hand**, **Forecasted**, **Moves**, **Reordering**) to inspect live warehouse stock directly from the product card. ![The Product form organizes General Information, Attributes & Variants, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, and Accounting tabs alongside live stock smart buttons.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/getting-started/product-form.webp)

Administrators maintain shared reference tables under **Settings → Reference Data**: * **Units of Measure**: Define categories (Units, Weight, Length, Volume, Time) and conversion ratios (for example, Dozen = 12 Units or Box = 24 Units) so purchasing in boxes automatically converts into units when received into stock. * **Currencies**: Activate foreign currencies, set currency symbols/rounding, and maintain dated exchange rates for multi-currency pricelists, invoices, vendor bills, and group consolidation. * **Languages**: Activate interface and document translation languages (such as English and Indonesian) so users can switch UI language and print customer documents in the partner's preferred language. * **Barcode Rules**: Configure barcode nomenclature rules (including GS1) for automated parsing during warehouse scanning.

* **Avoid Duplicate Partners**: Always search by name or tax ID before creating a new contact so receivable and payable balances stay consolidated under one partner ledger. * **Set Tracking Before First Stock Move**: Decide whether a product is tracked **By Lots** or **By Unique Serial Number** before receiving initial inventory; changing tracking after stock moves exist requires clearing or reconciling on-hand quants first. * **Keep Categories Aligned with Accounting**: Group products into meaningful categories (e.g., *Raw Materials*, *Finished Goods*, *Office Supplies*, *Services*) so Sales, Inventory Valuation, and P&L reporting stay clean.
